sections.heading: Overview

sections.content:
Wingecarribee Shire Council (Council) is seeking Expressions of Interest from qualified, engaging and passionate educators, facilitators and organisations to establish panel of preferred providers for the delivery of community waste reduction, reuse and sustainability workshops.
The panel will enable Council to engage suitable facilitators on an as-needed basis to deliver high-quality, practical education programs that encourage behavioural change, reduce avoidable waste to landfill, improve resource recovery and support Council’s broader sustainability objectives.
A more detailed brief of the extent of services required by Council is set out in Volume 1 - Specification which is included as part of the Expression of Interest documentation.
In accordance with Council Policy and Guidelines, Council invites Expressions of Interestin accordance with this Invitation and the following accompanying documents:
· Volume 1 - Specification
· Volume 2 - Response Schedules
· Volume 3 - Conditions of Contract, and
· Any published Addenda

sections.heading: Scope

sections.content:
Opportunity requirements
1.
Mandatory - Response Schedules
This Document contains Response Schedules to be completed and submitted as part of the Respondent’s proposal and will be used to evaluate the submission in accordance with the established Mandatory Criteria, Non-cost Weighted Criteria and Cost Weighted Criteria.
Response type
File upload (Multiple)
Response templates
2.
Mandatory - Public Liability Insurance - minimum $20 million
Insurance against the death or injury to any third party or parties or loss of or damage to any property including loss of use of property whether it is damaged or not whatsoever caused during the course of the contract. The policy shall have a limit of indemnity of not less than the amount indicated for any one occurrence.
Response type
File upload (Multiple)
3.
Mandatory - Workers Compensation Insurance
Workers Compensation/ Personal Accident  and Illness   Insurance or Personal Income Protection.
Insurance against any death of or injury to persons employed by the Supplier as required by the Workers Compensation Act 1987 .
In the event of the Contractor being a Sole Trader or Partnership, the Contractor must provide Council with a copy of either a Personal Accident and Illness   Insurance Policy or a Personal Income Protection Policy.
Response type
File upload (Multiple)
